system.description:
Defines how quickly Mana returns to the character. Source: Ikaris.

  • Level 1: Mana replenishes at a rate of 1/minute
  • Level 2: Mana replenishes at a rate of 1/5 minutes
  • Level 3: Mana replenishes at a rate of 5/hour
  • Level 4: Mana replenishes at a rate of 10/day
  • Level 5: Mana replenishes at a rate of 1/day
  • Level 6: Mana replenishes at a rate of 1/week
